Source record: docs/studies/analysis/pulsechain_restorative_review_20261004.md.
Validation of the restorative pDAI thesis
4 October 2026. Five model-based analysts, two review rounds. Saved evidence was inspected and
revalidated offline. Blockchain work remained read-only; no new chain calls or execution simulations
were performed.
Finding
FEI is optional and unusually easy to demonstrate. Its prominence reflects the clarity of its
evidence, rather than proven strategic importance. Its public conversion links existing FEI to
existing pDAI units. A route beginning with pDAI already needs that pDAI funded; the FEI step
redistributes resources. Direct pDAI use, Synthetix recycling, compatible issuer conversions and other
funded branches can serve complementary purposes.
All five final reviews accepted the conditional research account with no remaining priority revision in
their checked scope. They retained coordinated intent to benefit pDAI and PulseChain, normalized
eligible-stable accounting U, and distributed execution without an assumed central treasury or persistent
local stockpile. Agreement establishes review convergence, not observed intent, hidden key custody,
private-L2 deployment or sustained dollar capacity. The maintained white paper (main paper) contains
the resulting explanation.
The strongest supported formulation
The network has three distinct jobs: obtain usable resources, convert and distribute accepted assets,
and deliver the declared price service. Portal supplies destination credit with separate backing
obligations; issuers and wrappers create compatible claims or coins; funded markets pay the
counterassets. An independent executable dollar reference determines the payment quantities for the
dollar policy.
The proposed corrective loop buys below the target, meets demand with target-price offers, and restores
the inputs consumed. Funded conversions can transmit support through eligible connected markets
within their costs, capacity and timing. Under accessible, funded bid/offer terms at declared sizes and
deadlines, supported orders receive the declared band. This conditional result does not require every
optional protocol to operate, nor imply that every standalone AMM quote stays at the target.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 330

T arget-price sales recover payment capital and recirculate pDAI. Backing payments, productive positions,
venue refills and resale-support commitments compete for those resources across wallets. Shared 3pool
or FRAXBP cash counts once. As parity improves, arbitrage spreads can shrink; recycled capital, opposite
flows, new funded inputs and collectible net earnings remain possible replenishment sources. Future
interest from retired debts cannot finance later backing.
Claims a critical reader can test
Question Defensible claim and evidence boundary
Is FEI indispensable? No. Exact pDAI delivery can serve offers or eligible
reserves directly. FEI is a demonstrated optional relative-
parity interface, with finite cash and continuing claims.
Does assigning U establish $1? U compares normalized eligible assets. Dollar-linked
execution additionally needs an independently executable
reference and funded payment quantities.
Does receipt surplus guarantee complete buyback? Coverage requires permitted conversion into paid assets at
the required scale, after costs and competing obligations,
by the deadline. Nominal units alone do not establish
coverage.
Does profitable arbitrage necessarily improve pDAI's price? Complete closing flows determine direction. The observed
profitable sDAI cycle slightly lowered its closing pool's PLS/
pDAI ratio. Its net proceeds could finance separate support;
that later use remains to be traced.
Does supply adjustment refill every pool? Selling issued tokens consumes counterassets; deposits
and ordinary supply create different claims. Reverse
trades, funded redemption/contraction or new inputs
restore the required side. Pool-specific rebase accounting
remains necessary.
Does a successful local route prove fresh L2 funding? It proves the observed local capability. Fresh L2 funding
separately needs authenticated destination acceptance,
exact output, payer and source obligations. Instructions
can coordinate spending without delivering assets.
Does one unusable branch invalidate the architecture? It excludes that branch's contribution at the observed
checkpoint. A selected alternative must independently
satisfy the same asset, authority, funding and refill
requirements.
Is the research complete? The discussed architecture and route families are covered.
Exact integrated deployment, sustained paid capacity and
intent attribution remain open evidence questions.
These distinctions strengthen the argument while retaining its favorable purpose assumption. Each
proposed benefit can be tested through actual paid outcomes, useful reserve refills and reconciled
claims rather than inferred from protocol names or nominal balances.
Most valuable next evidence
Follow one complete funding → permitted use → acquisition or support → target-price
circulation → restored capacity sequence through whichever viable branch occurs. Do not
predetermine FEI as the destination. Record exact tokens, executors, payers, net outputs, continuing
claims, deadlines and the specific depleted resources replenished.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 331

A local sequence can establish local service. The private-L2 extension needs a fresh authenticated
destination entry; canonical Ethereum entry and exit require their own representation, custody and
release checks. Repeated dollar-responsive execution should use the paper's predeclared finite
benchmark, including failed requests and remaining next-order capacity. Broader flows, longer horizons
and source outages need separately stated coverage.
Method and reproduction
The analyst roles were mechanism, evidence, economics, network completeness and first-reader clarity.
First-round assessments used the same frozen paper separately. Second-round assessments checked the
revised explanation and two narrow operation/interest wording corrections. T en individual reports
preserve findings and checked scopes. reviews shared models, environment and sources; no calibrated
probability, exhaustive independent audit or actual human comprehension test is claimed.
The root reran two existing offline evidence verifiers: 2,111 equal-value checks and 132 arbitrage/
Maker checks passed. These reconcile retained receipts, traces, amounts, debt and accounting; they
do not update live state or cryptographically authenticate the chain. Source hashes, original link
preservation, the opening assumptions and document structure were checked separately.
The explicit batch is pulsechain_restorative_team_review_20261004.json. Frozen papers, ten
assessments, source index, verification outputs and hashes are under artifacts/pulsechain-restorative-
team-review-20261004/. The final reviewed freeze is paper-final-review.md, SHA-256 
4f1faf0655507e98668c7bcdeca671042b5c459eec8c1dd6b8337752a5d6e276; the maintained paper also links this
assessment. Earlier frozen evidence and research identities remain unchanged.
Reproduce the saved-evidence checks into new output files:
python Research/scripts/analyze_pulsechain_equal_value_routes.py \
  --input artifacts/pulsechain-equal-value-routes-20261003 \
  --output /tmp/pulsechain-restorative-equal-value.json
python Research/scripts/analyze_pulsechain_arbitrage_and_shutdown.py \
  --input artifacts/pulsechain-arbitrage-and-shutdown-20261003 \
  --prior artifacts/pulsechain-equal-value-routes-20261003 \
  --output /tmp/pulsechain-restorative-arbitrage.json
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 332
